spec.behavior: Replay a deterministic sensor-ring firmware core for N ticks. Each tick synthesizes a 12-bit ADC sample, validates a CRC-16 frame, writes valid samples into a fixed 16-slot ring, updates a fixed-point controller and simulated MMIO status/control registers, services a watchdog, and reports checksums over the register trace and final ring.

boundary.firmware_core: The tick loop models a no-OS core with fixed storage, deterministic arithmetic, and simulated registers; it performs no filesystem, network, clock, entropy, thread, or allocator operation.
boundary.host_adapter: The command-line argument and stdout are host replay adapters only. They are not a freestanding firmware or board-boot claim.
boundary.hardware: No physical MMIO, interrupt, DMA, board, or RTOS service is used; register addresses are represented by scalar state so every port has the same boundary.
